pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. You meet your teacher at eight o'clock in the morning. Which greeting fits best? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Gute Nacht
   C. Guten Morgen
   D. Tschüss

2. What does "Bis bald" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. please
   B. very good
   C. see you soon
   D. thank you

3. What does "der Vater" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. friend
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. father
   D. aunt

4. Which birthday wish means "All the best for your birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Appetit!
   B. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   C. Auf Wiedersehen!
   D. Gute Nacht!

5. What does "manchmal" mean? (1 mark)
   A. sometimes
   B. never
   C. often
   D. always

6. What does "Wie heißt du?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. see you soon
   C. please
   D. sorry, excuse me

7. How is the letter L named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ell
   B. eff
   C. bay
   D. tsay

8. How many umlaut letters does German have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 4

9. What does "das Messer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fork
   B. bathroom
   C. table
   D. knife

10. Which little word goes with the noun "Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

12. What does "die Woche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Wednesday
   C. Thursday
   D. Friday

13. What does "der Dienstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. week
   C. Tuesday
   D. Thursday

14. What is the plural of "das Lied"? (1 mark)
   A. die Lieder
   B. die Lieds
   C. die Liede
   D. die Lieden

15. What does "die Party" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. party
   C. birthday
   D. cake

16. What is the plural of "die Bohne"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohnes
   B. die Bohne
   C. die Bohner
   D. die Bohnen

17. What does "die Nase" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. nose
   B. head
   C. hand
   D. hair

18. What does "schwarze Haare" mean? (1 mark)
   A. small feet
   B. big hands
   C. brown eyes
   D. black hair

19. What does "klein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hard-working
   B. small
   C. funny
   D. strong

20. Which German word or phrase means "grandmother"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tochter
   B. die Oma
   C. der Vater
   D. der Bruder

21. Which German word means "strong"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. stark
   B. alt
   C. klein
   D. fleißig

22. Which little word goes with the noun "Schrank"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

23. What is the plural of "die Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. die Türs
   B. die Türen
   C. die Türe
   D. die Türer

24. Which German word means "to learn or study"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. sprechen
   C. lesen
   D. tanzen

25. What does "schwimmen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to have a shower
   C. to sing
   D. to swim

26. Which German word means "to smell"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. duschen
   B. trinken
   C. riechen
   D. lernen

27. What does "der achte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eighth
   B. seventh
   C. tenth
   D. third

28. What does "August" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. August
   C. September
   D. July

29. Which German word means "March"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Februar
   B. Januar
   C. November
   D. März

30. Which German word or phrase means "onion"? (1 mark)
   A. die Milch
   B. die Karotte
   C. der Saft
   D. die Zwiebel

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

32. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)

34. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

35. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

36. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

37. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)

40. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

41. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)

42. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

44. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

45. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

46. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Guten Morgen
   Morgen means morning, so Guten Morgen is the greeting for the morning.

2. C — see you soon
   Bis bald means see you soon.

3. C — father
   der Vater means father.

4. B — Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Alles Gute zum Geburtstag is the usual birthday wish.

5. A — sometimes
   manchmal means sometimes.

6. A — What is your name?
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?.

7. A — ell
   In German the letter L is called ell.

8. C — 3
   The umlauts are ä, ö and ü.

9. D — knife
   das Messer means knife.

10. A — das
   It is das Bett, so the little word is das.

11. B — die
   It is die Tür, so the little word is die.

12. A — week
   die Woche means week.

13. C — Tuesday
   der Dienstag means Tuesday.

14. A — die Lieder
   The plural of das Lied is die Lieder.

15. B — party
   die Party means party.

16. D — die Bohnen
   The plural of die Bohne is die Bohnen.

17. A — nose
   die Nase means nose.

18. D — black hair
   schwarz = black, Haare = hair.

19. B — small
   klein means small.

20. B — die Oma
   grandmother in German is die Oma.

21. A — stark
   strong in German is stark.

22. A — der
   It is der Schrank, so the little word is der.

23. B — die Türen
   The plural of die Tür is die Türen.

24. A — lernen
   to learn or study in German is lernen.

25. D — to swim
   schwimmen means to swim.

26. C — riechen
   to smell in German is riechen.

27. A — eighth
   der achte means eighth.

28. B — August
   August means August.

29. D — März
   March in German is März.

30. D — die Zwiebel
   onion in German is die Zwiebel.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).
